why: Target opponent's face (player B, 12 life). Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage, reducing them to 9 life. In a race situation where I'm at critical life total (5) and cannot stabilize through blocking, I must maximize face damage. This turn's total output: 3 (Lightning Bolt) + 4 (Giant attack, if unblocked) + 2 (Dragon Fodder tokens) = 9 damage if unblocked, bringing them to 3 life. While they will still likely attack and kill me (6 damage from Rumbling Baloth + Grizzly Bears), dealing maximum damage gives me the best chance to find a topdecked solution or force them into a precarious position.
